description: Reads the registrants (leads) of a webinar from the host's own WordPress site: name, email, phone, signup time, attended, watched replay, purchased, UTM source — plus, when the site provides it, what each lead spent and which products they bought. Read-only, it changes nothing. Use it when the host asks who registered, how many leads came in, whom to follow up, or what a single lead bought. Do not use it for pure aggregate numbers (that is wi_get_webinar_funnel_conversion_stats) and not for deleting or exporting a list. A licence that includes the registrant export is required: otherwise the site answers code 'license_required' with an upgrade link and no registrant data. Without a connected site the answer carries example numbers (sample: true) and the next step.

limit.description: How many registrants to return, 1-200. Default 50.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id. Leave it out when the session already built one.

name: wi_list_webinar_leads_registrants
title: List webinar registrants and leads
